# Trinova Health

> > Trinova Health is a Tampa-based compounding pharmacy specializing in personalized medications including LDN, BHRT, and alternative cancer treatments, with integrated telehealth services for weight management and cosmetic care.

Founded by Dr. Eugene Papantoniou, Trinova Health combines traditional pharmacy expertise with innovative compounding and telehealth solutions. The practice serves patients across Tampa and St. Petersburg, offering both in-pharmacy services and remote consultations for specialized treatments.

## Key Topics

- Low Dose Naltrexone (LDN)
- Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy (BHRT)
- Compounded Medications
- Dr. Eugene Papantoniou
- Fenbendazole
- Mebendazole
- Cancer Treatment
- Telehealth Services
- GLP-1 Semaglutide
- Hair Restoration
- Pain Management
- Weight Management
- Personalized Medication
- Tampa Pharmacy
- Clinical Expertise
